item.title: ESA selects Isar Aerospace for 4 missions under the European Launcher Challenge
item.description: ESA selects Isar Aerospace to fly 4 missions between 2027 and 2030 under the European Launcher Challenge.

ESA selects Isar Aerospace for 4 missions under the European Launcher Challenge

ESA selects Isar Aerospace to fly 4 missions between 2027 and 2030 under the European Launcher Challenge, the agency announced on Tuesday.

The selection follows the evaluation of proposals from European launch service providers. The missions will carry institutional payloads to low Earth orbit with the Spectrum launcher.

“Competition is how Europe secures autonomous access to space,” the Director of Space Transportation said.

item.title: Ariane 6 launches two Galileo satellites
item.description: Two Galileo navigation satellites were placed into orbit by Ariane 6 from Europe's Spaceport in French Guiana.
item.content:encoded:
Applications > Satellite navigation

Two Galileo navigation satellites were placed into orbit by Ariane 6 from Europe's Spaceport in French Guiana on Tuesday evening.

The satellites, operated for the European Commission, join the Galileo constellation. ESA managed the deployment on behalf of the EU.
